description: Validates that MCP tools sanitize path inputs to prevent traversal

rules.title: Path input sanitization
rules.description: All MCP tools that accept filesystem path arguments must use sanitizePathInput() to prevent path traversal attacks.
rules.validationQuery: sanitizePathInput() called on all path arguments

rules.title: Base directory containment
rules.description: Resolved paths must be verified to remain within the intended base directory after resolution.
rules.validationQuery: Path resolved and verified against base directory
